_comment: Single source of truth for Anchor environments (Dev/Prod), seeded prompts, and the request/webhook links. Read by the desktop app, the Flutter app, and the CD-flow simulator (anchor_sim.html). phase3_up.sh fills the production anchor/webhook with the real VM ip:port at cutover — switching the dropdown to 'production' is then the only change needed.

development.label: Development (Phase 2 — ALL LOCAL, tested before deploy)

production.label: Production (Phase 3 — anchor + web ONLINE on the Azure VM; desktop stays local)
production._note: Remote web/mobile CANNOT reach the local brain — EVERYTHING goes through the online anchor (async: request -> fast ack -> local desktop -> webhook/poll result). Ports are hard-to-guess on purpose.
production._ports_note: 48619/48620 are LOCALHOST-only on the VM (never public). The public entry is nginx 443 via the reverse proxy paths below — no new ports, only 80/443/22 open.

seeded_prompts.label: Recent orders (Veeqo / Fulfillment)
seeded_prompts.prompt: How many orders did we get this week, and what is the recent shipping status?

seeded_prompts.label: Klaviyo workflows (Email)
seeded_prompts.prompt: List our recent Klaviyo email workflows with their live vs draft counts.

seeded_prompts.label: Total order count
seeded_prompts.prompt: What is our total order count right now?

seeded_prompts.prompt: What is the current deployment status of the sandbox app?
